issue_title: Empty table dumped when number of subtables > 1
issue_text:
Empty table dumped when number of subtables > 1

With the following code and `tomlkit 0.13`:

```python
import tomlkit

doc = tomlkit.document()

def add_table(parent, name):
    parent.add(name, tomlkit.table())
    return parent[name]


root = add_table(doc, 'root')
first = add_table(root, "first")
print(tomlkit.dumps(doc))  # -> [root.first]   (correct)

second = add_table(root, "second")
print(tomlkit.dumps(doc))  # -> [root]\n[root.first]\n\n[root.second]\n  (wrong: empty [root] header appears)
```

When a super table has more than one sub-table, dumping produces an empty `[root]` header that should not be shown. With a single sub-table the output is correct.

Repo version: tomlkit 0.13.0. Reproduction test file: tests/test_real_issues_411_377_381.py::test_issue_377_no_empty_parent_header_for_super_table
success_criteria: The selected test passes; dumping a super table with multiple sub-tables does not emit an empty parent header.
